name: Verna Furlbrow
summary: Near Westfall’s northern border, Verna Furlbrow waits beside her broken wagon. Outlaws drove her from the family pumpkin patch, and the road toward Elwynn Forest left her stranded.

sections.title: A String of Misfortunes
sections.body:
Verna and her husband farmed pumpkins in northern Westfall until lawlessness drove them away. Outlaws took the farm, so they loaded what they could onto their cart and set out for Elwynn Forest with their horse, Old Blanchy. Their wagon broke down just down the road from the abandoned Jansen Stead.

The broken axle keeps them from going on. Verna faces the elements, bandit raids, and scavengers, and depends on travelers to keep her household fed and guarded.

sections.title: Heart of the Hearth
sections.body:
Verna still welcomes those forced to the roadside. Known across the region for creating Westfall Stew, she shares meals and warm fires with wandering transients and refugees who have suffered similar fates.

Her cooking pot needs ingredients from the fields: boar snouts, murloc eyes, okra, and stringy vulture meat. From what the harsh frontier provides, Verna makes hearty meals for the destitute.

faq.q: Why is Verna Furlbrow camped along the road?
faq.answer: Verna and her husband fled their pumpkin farm after outlaws overran northern Westfall. Their wagon broke down near the Jansen Stead as they traveled toward Elwynn Forest, leaving them stranded beside the road.

faq.q: Who is Farmer Furlbrow to her?
faq.answer: Farmer Theodore Furlbrow is Verna's husband. They worked their Westfall homestead together until bandits drove them from their land.
Westfall Stew is a frontier dish Verna created. She makes it with wild boar snouts, stringy vulture meat, murloc eyes, and okra gathered from neighboring abandoned farms to feed stranded refugees.

faq.q: What happened to the Furlbrows' farm?
faq.answer: Organized bandits took the Furlbrows' pumpkin farm in northern Westfall during the kingdom's recent breakdown in security. The Furlbrows had to leave their home and fields.

angles.text: Verna created Westfall Stew and teaches frontier cooks to make a hearty meal from scavenged meats and wild crops.
The stranded Furlbrows show the human cost of Stormwind's neglected borders. Ordinary people are driven from their homes without royal soldiers sent to defend them.
